title: Agentic commerce outlook: McKinsey $3-5T by 2030 vs Gartner 40% cancellations by 2027
content: McKinsey projects a $3-5 trillion agentic commerce opportunity by 2030 while Gartner predicts more than 40% of agentic AI projects will be cancelled by end of 2027. These may be compatible (a shakeout followed by concentration among survivors is the normal shape of infrastructure booms), but the vault should not treat trillion-scale projections as settled. Resolution likely arrives 2027-2028 as B2B adoption data comes in.
resolution: Dissolved: the two forecasts measure different quantities over different horizons — a 2030 market size against project cancellations by end-2027 — and are compatible through the ordinary shakeout-then-concentration shape of an infrastructure build-out, which both sources describe when they say the rails are ahead of demand. The boundary is now written into both notes, together with what the pair does establish: neither figure is settled, they are a scenario range, and 2027-2028 B2B adoption data is the discriminating evidence.
description: Bull and bear forecasts for the agentic economy diverge sharply: trillion-scale commerce projections coexist with mass project-cancellation predictions.
